title: Suzuki Gixxer 250
text:
Suzuki Gix 250
coming soon
This bike gets a bad rap, and the stereotype giving rise to that rap are not unfounded. Just as surons are now claimed associated with undedeveloped frontal lobe teenage boys - Gixxer 250’s immediately conjure images of brocli headed high-schoolers racing their Gixxer 250 against their friends shit box alteza. In fact, I suspect the characters fitting these stereotypes (Suron and Gixxer 250), overlap quite a bit.
It’d be a shame to not give this bike some thought, though. It’s a stylish, petrol efficient, and peppy little bike with modern technology. And the biggest draw - it’s $4,999 NZD brand new. Am I missing something other people aren’t? Why do more people not buy this bike? That’s really cheap for a brand new little commuter. And it’s Suzuki, so although the bike is made in China surely we can trust its engineering. I mean BMW’s are made in India now too so everyone’s doing it.
The damn Kawasaki KLX300 is priced at $9,177. The Honda GB350S is $8,995. Even the fricken CF MOTO 250 cc bikes are over $7,400 NZD.
not as flicky as I thought it would be? geometry seems to promote long sweeping turns.
It’s clear that Suzuki has pushed as much out of this engine as they could.
